description: Agent-based diffusion model of behavior adoption on a social network with peer influence, media exposure, misinformation, and policy interventions (incentives + moderation).

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the social network and initializes agent attributes with homophily.

notes: Homophily is implemented via degree-preserving edge swaps.
Assortativity on thresholds is optional to cluster similar agents.
Thresholds and susceptibilities are agent heterogeneities.

modules.name: PolicyModule
modules.description: Schedules and applies platform-level incentives and moderation over time.

update_rule.pseudocode:
day = signal.clock.day
active = (policy.start_day <= day <= policy.end_day)
if not active:
  moderation = 0.0
  incentive = 0.0
else:
  t_rel = max(0, min(day - policy.start_day, policy.ramp_up_days))
  ramp = t_rel / max(1, policy.ramp_up_days)
  moderation = ramp * policy.moderation_strength
  incentive = ramp * policy.incentive_amount
policy_state = { 'moderation': moderation, 'incentive': incentive, 'target_group': policy.target_group, 'active': active }
emit signal.policy_state = policy_state
notes: Linear ramp-up allows smooth activation over policy.ramp_up_days.
Targeting can gate incentives to specific groups at downstream modules.

modules.name: InteractionEngine
modules.description: Generates daily exposures via network messaging and media broadcast; applies moderation to misinformation flow.

update_rule.pseudocode:
G = signal.network
state = signal.agent_state_prev
pol = signal.policy_state
for agent i:
  messages = Poisson(interaction.messages_per_day)
  choose 'messages' neighbors uniformly from G.neighbors(i) with replacement
  peer_adopt_exposures = count of chosen neighbors with adopted=True
  media_exposures = Bernoulli(interaction.media_broadcast_rate)
  total_pro_adopt = peer_adopt_exposures + media_exposures
  # Misinformation arrivals
  base_mis = Binomial(messages, misinformation.rate)
  moderated_mis = Binomial(base_mis, (1 - pol.moderation))
  # Record
  exposures[i] = { 'pro_adopt': total_pro_adopt, 'misinfo': moderated_mis }
# Aggregate misinfo fraction for observability
misinfo_fraction = sum_i exposures[i].misinfo / max(1, sum_i (exposures[i].pro_adopt + exposures[i].misinfo))
emit signal.exposures = exposures and signal.misinfo_fraction = misinfo_fraction
notes: Media broadcast rate adds non-network exposures.
Sampling with replacement approximates multiple contacts.

modules.name: InfluenceUpdate
modules.description: Updates beliefs and adoption states using a logistic threshold model with peer/media influence and policy incentives, and allows abandonment.

update_rule.pseudocode:
state_prev = signal.agent_state_prev
exp = signal.exposures
pol = signal.policy_state
for agent i:
  s = state_prev[i]
  # Influence accumulation
  peer_term = influence.peer_weight * exp[i].pro_adopt
  media_term = influence.media_weight * exp[i].pro_adopt * content.base_quality
  incentive_term = pol.incentive * (1.0 if pol.target_group=='all' or pol.target_group==s.group else 0.0)
  mis_term = s.credulity * exp[i].misinfo
  raw_score = s.susceptibility * (peer_term + media_term + incentive_term - mis_term)
  # Convert to probability relative to threshold
  # p_adopt = sigmoid( (raw_score / (1 + exp[i].pro_adopt + exp[i].misinfo)) - s.threshold ) + adoption.spontaneous_rate
  denom = 1 + exp[i].pro_adopt + exp[i].misinfo
  z = (raw_score / denom) - s.threshold
  p_adopt = 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-z)) + adoption.spontaneous_rate
  p_adopt = min(max(p_adopt, 0.0), 1.0)
  if s.adopted:
    # possibility of abandonment
    abandon = Bernoulli(adoption.decay_rate)
    adopted = (not abandon)
  else:
    adopted = Bernoulli(p_adopt)
  belief_score = min(1.0, max(0.0, s.belief_score + 0.1*(p_adopt - 0.5) - 0.1*(exp[i].misinfo/denom)))
  new_state[i] = s updated with adopted and belief_score
emit signal.agent_state = new_state
notes: Logistic decision compares normalized influence to an agent-specific threshold.
Policy incentives act as an additive pro-adoption term.
Abandonment models fatigue or switching behavior.

modules.name: Aggregator
modules.description: Computes daily aggregate observables for calibration and evaluation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
N = population.size
adoption_rate = mean_i(new_state[i].adopted)
exposure_rate = mean_i(exposures[i].pro_adopt + exposures[i].misinfo)
misinfo_prev = signal.misinfo_fraction
if day == 0:
  cumulative = round(adoption_rate * N)
else:
  cumulative = prev_cumulative + round((adoption_rate - prev_adoption_rate) * N)
emit all signals
notes: Cumulative adopters are tracked incrementally; ensure non-decreasing.
Exposure rate counts total daily messages per agent.

algorithms.network_generation: Watts-Strogatz small-world, Barabasi-Albert scale-free, or Erdos-Renyi random graph with homophily rewiring and optional threshold assortativity.
algorithms.exposure_sampling: Poisson sampling of messages per agent with neighbor selection (with replacement); Bernoulli media broadcast; moderation as binomial thinning.
algorithms.adoption_decision: Logistic-threshold model combining peer and media influence, incentives, and misinformation penalties; with spontaneous adoption and abandonment.
algorithms.aggregation: Daily means and cumulative sums with optional moving average smoothing.
